## Changes made from the upstream version

Modified by SkillOffice on 2026-11-06:

- Renamed from roadmap-update to pm-roadmap; rewrote in SkillOffice format as a numbered process; body about 75 lines.
- Removed the project tracker connector steps, the offer to update ticket statuses and the slash-command usage block. The user provides the roadmap.
- Made the capacity check an explicit step; added a rule that customer-facing versions avoid firm dates and need the user's approval.
- Moved roadmap formats, prioritization methods (RICE, ICE, MoSCoW, value versus effort), dependency, capacity and communication guidance into `references/roadmap-methods.md`, condensed.
- Team and process context comes from the SkillOffice context profile; dates follow regional settings.
- Added a quality checklist, a safety note and a handoff section.

Modified by SkillOffice on 2026-11-17 (version 0.2.0): added an "Ask first" section (original SkillOffice content).
